end.summary:
Named radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment and sector; this was shown in a why/new-situation check.
Practised diameter–radius–chord relationships; some answers were right, and this needs another steady check next time.
Described reflection and rotation symmetry; this was shown in a why/new-situation check.
Teach-back was not passed; two later questions received “I don’t know” responses.
end.parentNote: Asha practised circle vocabulary using examples such as a pizza slice, a straight cut, and parts between a chord and an arc. Dev gave clear reasons for why a diameter is the longest chord and identified that a circle has many lines of reflection symmetry; the diameter–radius–chord relationship still needs another check, and two later questions were not answered. At home, ask Dev to label a drawn circle and explain one example each of a radius, chord, sector and segment.
